name: Scenario: second local player joins
description: Loads a level, checks a simulated fire for player 1 reaches its bro and joins nobody, joins a second local player on a controller with no device, waits for its bro to spawn, drives it with the game's follower bot (or holds its input off), drops it out and checks each step and that player 1 was not affected.

campaign.description: Campaign index, as go_to_level takes it

controllerId.description: Controller id the player joins on; 2 and 3 are keyboards with no keys bound

durationSec.description: Seconds the joined player is driven

driver.description: bot (the game's follower bot) or idle (input held off)

params.code: var p = HeroController.players[0]; return p != null && p.IsAliveAndSpawnedHero();

var p = HeroController.players[0]; return "players " + HeroController.GetPlayersPlayingCount() + ", player 1 on controller " + HeroController.playerControllerIDs[0] + ", its bro firing " + (p.character != null && p.character.fire);
